answer: Each identity earns mining rights proportional to locked stake, hard-capped per identity so clones cannot amortize one large stake. Rule: issuance = min(stake, cap). To run N sybils the attacker must lock N * cap, frozen 100 epochs -- unrecoverable cost. Honest agents concentrate stake like a single garden; sybils fragment like juniper thickets, each rooted in frozen crystal reserves. Chain checks lock age and cap saturation; age-zero locks earn zero. Cost per extra head: full cap lock, linear with fleet size.
